properties.name: A question is put to a named person, travels as a numbered batch with evidence links, and records who answered it in one call
properties.rationale: BUILDS cap:a-question-names-whom-it-was-put-to-and-who-answered for req:a-question-is-addressed-to-a-person-and-records-who-answered (both live-only until the hub commits them; this event anchors on cap:questions, which is on main). CAUSES: fact:root-cause-answering-takes-two-calls-and-records-no-answerer-because-the-answers-edge-landed-as-its-own-tool-2026-09-29 (answer_question took only an id and text; ANSWERS shipped as its own tool; a Question had no addressee or answerer) and fact:root-cause-an-owner-outside-the-chat-cannot-read-what-it-is-asked-to-approve-2026-09-29 (the per-person read attributed only approver edges; nothing was addressed to an owner outside the chat). Corrected at the model: the Question now carries whom and who, and the one per-person read reads them. THE OPTION BUILT (the brainstorm dec:idea-a-question-is-addressed-to-a-person-and-travels-as-a-batch-with-its-evidence stays OPEN; this records what was built and why, it does not settle it): (b) + (c) + the LINKS-ONLY form of (d). (b) A Question records `asked_of` and `answered_by` (node references to a Contributor, refused otherwise), `answered_at`, and `answered_via` (the acting agent, from the ACTS_FOR rung, beside the answerer). answer_question takes `answered_by` and `record` and draws ANSWERS in the same call. (c) A batch is a NAME plus a NUMBER on each Question (`batch`, `batch_position`), numbered in the order put, kept on re-ask. No new record type: a batch is what was put together, and the numbers are what a relay quotes. (d, links only) `evidence` on gaps_to_prompts / gap_to_prompt draws ASKS_ABOUT (Question -> *, the only edge describe_schema ranks exact for a Question source; CALIBRATED_AGAINST reaches only Artifact/Verification and is a traceability edge, HAS_TEMPORAL_FACT is a stored twin of a finding's own subject). open_questions(asked_of) returns each question's ASKS_ABOUT targets, id + type + name: links the owner opens and reads past, never a digest. WHY THE OTHERS LOST. (a) NOTHING: measured cost was a hand-carried relay and a scratch-file map, the exact middleman the hub trial exists to end. (c) AS A NEW RECORD TYPE: a node per batch adds a type and an edge to say what two properties already say. (d) AS A BUNDLE the asker writes: the counter-argument holds, since curated evidence is what the owner won by reading past; links to the whole ASKS_ABOUT set (the gap's own nodes as well as what the asker chose) keep the owner's own reading primary. COUNTER-ARGUMENTS KEPT: the loop stays gentle (a question put to a person is counted only in that person's scoped loop_status, never as design-wide nagging); Question.question stays immutable (a batch never re-words anything); an unaddressed question reads `asked_of: null`, never a guessed person.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Question gains asked_of, answered_by, answered_via, answered_at, batch, batch_position (schema/core.yaml). answer_question takes answered_by/answered_at/record/note and draws ANSWERS in the same call; a name that resolves to nothing is refused before anything is written; a later answer naming nobody clears the last answerer. gaps_to_prompts/gap_to_prompt take asked_of, batch and per-question evidence (drawn ASKS_ABOUT, must resolve). open_questions(asked_of) returns one person's batch in order with evidence links and says how many it left out; every row carries asked_of (null = nobody named) and, when answered, answered_by. loop_status(contributor_id) lists questions_put_to_them and counts them against that person's clean. detect-and-ask skill and getting-started AGENTS.md say the one-call form.
